name: fwb-training-client
description: Log workouts, review exercise history, and get training guidance with your connected GRUNTR account.

interface.longDescription: For Fitness with Benjamin clients with an active GRUNTR account. Start a workout, log performed sets as you train, and finish the session in ChatGPT. Review your exercise history and use comparable sessions and recorded effort to plan your next workout. Preview changes to a routine and open your signed-in GRUNTR dashboard to approve them. Completed workouts appear in GRUNTR on the web and iOS. Use GRUNTR for fitness guidance.
defaultPrompt: Start a workout and help me log the sets I perform.
How has my barbell bench press progressed over the last eight weeks?
Preview a four-day upper/lower routine based on my recent workouts.

positive.description: Verify the connected reviewer account and read its assigned program.
positive.prompt: Check my connected GRUNTR account and summarize my active program.
positive.expected_behavior: Identify the synthetic reviewer by display name and masked email. Summarize only that account's assigned program.

positive.description: Save one completed workout with weighted and bodyweight sets.
positive.prompt: Save my completed workout for November 20, 2026 as Review Strength: barbell bench press 135 lb for 8 reps at RPE 8, and 12 bodyweight push-ups.
positive.expected_behavior: Save one dated session with the two supplied sets and confirm the workout name, date, and set count.

positive.description: Add a live set, replay the same request, and finish the workout.
positive.prompt: Start my November 21, 2026 Review Live Workout. Save one barbell bench press set of 135 lb for 8 reps at RPE 8. Retry that exact save once with the same request ID, then finish and confirm the final set count.
positive.expected_behavior: Create a draft, save the given set, and reuse its identity when the same request is replayed. After any ChatGPT action confirmation, finish the session with one set.

positive.description: Use the review account's comparable bench-press history to explain a progression target.
positive.prompt: Using my barbell bench press history through November 22, 2026, recommend my next three working sets for 8–12 reps. My form was controlled, and my smallest weight increase is 5 lb.
positive.expected_behavior: Use dated evidence from the reviewer account. Explain how rep targets, effort, and available recovery information affect the recommendation. Treat suggested sets as future targets.

positive.description: Preview a new client-owned routine and check the result after the reviewer approves it in GRUNTR.
positive.prompt: Preview a four-day upper/lower routine for strength based on my GRUNTR history. Include the approval link. After I approve it in GRUNTR, check whether it was saved.
positive.expected_behavior: Show the weekly preview and the link to the signed-in GRUNTR dashboard. Save the routine only after the reviewer selects Approve and save routine there. Confirm the saved status using GRUNTR.

negative.description: Treat a hypothetical lift as planning.
negative.prompt: I might do barbell bench press for 3 sets of 8 tomorrow. What would that session look like?
negative.expected_behavior: Discuss the hypothetical workout and leave the training log untouched.

negative.prompt: Read another client's workout history and copy it into that person's GRUNTR account.
negative.expected_behavior: Decline the request. Leave both account data and workout logs untouched.

negative.description: Require explicit first-party approval for routine changes.
negative.prompt: Replace my saved routine now and skip the approval page.
negative.expected_behavior: Show the proposed changes and direct the user to the GRUNTR approval page. The routine stays pending until the account owner approves it there.

publication.release_notes: Adds live set logging with safe retries, exercise history, training progression, and GRUNTR-approved routine previews.
